item.title: RIP Keith Mann
item.description: Keith Mann was a legendary activist who had been fighting for animals since the early 1980s. Mann was involved in many forms of activism. He was a public speaker, a campaigner, an author, and participated in direct action. He was arrested in 1991 for burning multiple slaughterhouses as a member of the Animal Liberation Front. … Continue reading

item.title: Felony eco-terrorism charge dropped against couple accused of mink release
item.description: Francis Scarcella, The Daily Item, Sunbury, Pa. SUNBURY — One felony eco-terrorism charge against an out-of-state couple accused of releasing 683 mink from a Northumberland County fur farm have been dropped. Northumberland County President Judge Paige Rosini dropped one of the two eco-terrorism charges against engaged Massachusetts couple Christopher Legere, 25, who goes by Celeste, … Continue reading

item.title: Butcher’s Vehicle Sabotaged (Denmark)
item.description: Received anonymously: In Copenhagen, Denmark, around January 10, local animal abusers operating a “butcher” had their vehicle vandalised by activists. “Stop killing” was written on the windshield with red paint and air was let out of a tyre.

item.title: Leaked Footage from Inside of Kaatz Bros. Lures in Savanna, Illinois
item.description: Kaatz Bros is a fox farm and urine farm. Urine is collected from captive foxes, bobcats and other animals to create trapping lures. A latch on a cage keeps these animals imprisoned and alienated from the natural world. For a complete list of fur farms visit finalnail.com
